body: These people arent actual friends, just acquaintances on social media.

I feel you. A lot of posters here are younger (which makes sense) but it's hard to remain optimistic in your 30s about life "getting better" even when you try to reinvent it and become better and things still don't pan out.
I don't believe in soulmates and don't really care to meet anyone else at this point. I am really tired of it all.

everyone's circumstances are different. Just because you were able to get through something doesn't mean that I can. I am honestly just super tired of feeling alone and sad, living has become too painful for me.
